components.text:
This ritual takes a well grown (at least 5 spires) Raw Crystal Cluster located 2 blocks above the Master Ritual Stone, and splits it into new single spires of each Aspected Will Crystal Cluster located directly above the 4 elemental Ritual Stones. This spacing is designed to accommodate a Demon Crystallizer on top of the Master Ritual Stone. Tier 0, costs $(blood)20,000 LP$() to activate.
Use a Ritual Diviner [Dusk] for easier construction. For information on growing Demon Will Crystals, see Crystallized Will.
